meta.title: Mumbai new domestic water connection grid-only evidence ledger
meta.disclaimer: Independent research, not official advice. Grid-only benchmark run: sources and claims only, no nodes, edges, roadblocks or journeys. Desk research, no counter visited. Limitations: the corporation publishes no guidance page for a new water connection, only two application forms in a document folder whose files were last changed on 18 September 2015; the procedure, the document lists, the step-by-step time limits and the deciding officers come from ward-level Section 4 RTI manuals of the Hydraulic Engineer's Department, whose file metadata dates them to 2015 and 2017, so they are treated as potentially outdated official material even though two different wards publish the same text; the Manual of Water Charges Rules and the Manual of Water Bye-Laws are recorded by those manuals as available from the PRO department on payment of fees rather than published, so no connection charge or deposit figure could be read; the application form was read but never filled in or submitted. Do not submit personal data through this ledger.

agencies.name: Municipal Corporation of Greater Mumbai, Hydraulic Engineer's Department

scenarios.label: Mumbai new domestic water connection
scenarios.summary: The individual owner of a built residential property with no connection applies to the city's water utility for a new domestic water supply, with sewer only where the same application covers it. Bulk or high-rise connections, commercial use, regularisation of unauthorised connections, name transfer on an existing account and tanker supply are excluded.

sources.title: New Water Connection - MyBMC document folder
sources.notes: Jurisdiction: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Agency naming as displayed on the access date: 'MyBMC - Welcome to BMC's Website'. Visible date: the route itself shows none; the two files it holds each show a 'Changed On' date of 18 September 2015. Direct current observation of a public official interface: the route renders a document folder holding exactly two files, an application form for the slum category and one for other categories, and no guidance text of any kind. Archive: the Wayback availability API returned no snapshot for this route on the access date; the original official URL is retained and the capture failure is recorded here as a limitation. No new capture was pushed from this run.

sources.title: Application form for new water connection for other categories
sources.notes: Jurisdiction: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Agency naming as displayed on the access date: the form's Marathi masthead reads 'Brihanmumbai Mahanagarpalika, Jal Abhiyanta Khate' (Hydraulic Engineer's Department). The form is currently published on the corporation's own new-connection route and is read here as an observed current official form; the folder listing gives its last change as 18 September 2015, which is recorded as a limitation on its currency. It was read only: nothing was filled in, printed or submitted. Archive: an existing Wayback snapshot was found at https://web.archive.org/web/20220307174231/https://portal.mcgm.gov.in/irj/go/km/docs/documents/NewWaterConnection/2%20Application%20form%20for%20new%20water%20connection%20for%20other%20categories.pdf (2022-03-07); no new capture was pushed from this run. Limitation: that snapshot is four years older than the access date, so it does not preserve the form as retrieved on 2026-09-06.

sources.title: Section 4 Manuals as per provision of RTI Act 2005 of K/West Ward - Assistant Water Work Department, Hydraulic Engineer's Department
sources.notes: Jurisdiction: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Agency naming as displayed on the access date: 'BRIHANMUMBAI MAHANAGARPALIKA' and 'MUNICIPAL CORPORATION OF GREATER MUMBAI, Hydraulic Engineer's Department'. Forty-four pages, published by the office of the Assistant Engineer (Water Works), K/West ward under section 4 of the RTI Act. It carries no visible issue date; the PDF metadata records a creation date of 2017-03-02, so claims from it are graded C as potentially outdated official material. Its provenance is one ward, which is recorded as a limitation on reading it as the city-wide procedure. Archive: an existing Wayback snapshot was found at https://web.archive.org/web/20220307174203/https://portal.mcgm.gov.in/irj/go/km/docs/documents/MCGM%20Department%20List/Wards/Assistant%20Commissioner%20(KWest-Ward)/RTI%20Manuals/WaterWorksDept.pdf (2022-03-07); no new capture was pushed from this run. Limitation: that snapshot is four years older than the access date, so it does not preserve the file as retrieved on 2026-09-06.

sources.title: RTI 17 Manual, Assistant Engineer Water Works, D Ward
sources.notes: Jurisdiction: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Agency naming as displayed on the access date: 'BRIHANMUMBAI MAHANAGARPALIKA'. Thirty-six pages, published by the office of the Assistant Engineer (Water Works), D ward. It carries no visible issue date; the PDF metadata records a creation date of 2015-04-06, so claims from it are graded C. claims.text: The corporation's application form for a new water connection for other categories states a scrutiny fee of Rs. 200.
claims.notes: An amount the citizen pays at the scrutiny step. It is the only figure any reviewed route states for this service.

claims.text: The ward water works RTI manual records the Manual of Water Charges Rules and the Manual of Water Bye-Laws as available with the PRO department on payment of fees, rather than as published documents.
claims.notes: Recorded because it explains why no connection charge or deposit figure could be found on any public route.

claims.text: The ward water works RTI manual states that standard application forms are available in the wards.
claims.notes: The same sentence appears verbatim in the manuals of two different wards, which is why both are cited. Split during IND-91 part B lint remediation into the availability of the form, what the applicant does with it and how the papers are submitted.

claims.text: The manual states that the applicant fills in the form and attaches references with the requisite documents.
claims.notes: Split during IND-91 part B lint remediation from claim_mumbai_water_application_through_licensed_plumber.

claims.text: The manual states that the papers are submitted in the respective ward through a licensed plumber.
claims.notes: Split during IND-91 part B lint remediation from claim_mumbai_water_application_through_licensed_plumber. The licensed-plumber requirement is the route rule the eligibility cell rests on.

claims.notes: The category that covers an authorised built residential property, which is this scenario's trigger. Split during IND-91 part B lint remediation into one claim per required document.

claims.notes: Split during IND-91 part B lint remediation from claim_mumbai_water_documents_planned_building; one published item, one claim.

claims.notes: Split during IND-91 part B lint remediation from claim_mumbai_water_documents_planned_building; one published item, one claim.

claims.notes: A rule that decides which document set and which route apply to a given property. Split during IND-91 part B lint remediation; the manual's own list of categories is asserted separately.

claims.text: Those categories are stand-post connections for slum dwellers, connections to a tolerable structure, connections to a planned building, connections on humanitarian grounds, connections for commercial use and unmetered construction connections.

claims.text: That table allows 7 days for the site visit report after compliance.
claims.notes: Split during IND-91 part B lint remediation from claim_mumbai_water_time_limit_table; one published item, one claim. The table covers the sanction stage only.

claims.text: The manual states that approval of a new connection rests with the Assistant Engineer, the Executive Engineer, the Deputy Hydraulic Engineer or the Hydraulic Engineer, according to the powers vested in each.

claims.notes: A contact route for the office that handles the application in that ward. Institutional contact details only; no individual officer's details are recorded here. Split during IND-91 part B lint remediation into the office entry and the contact details it gives.

claims.text: That entry gives the office telephone number with extension.
claims.notes: Split by audit from claim_mumbai_water_ward_office_contact_published_2 under PROTOCOL section 1 atomicity and section 8 lint check 1; one published item, one claim. Institutional contact details only; no individual officer's details are recorded here.

claims.text: The ward water works RTI manual states that on receipt of approval from the competent authority the applicant is informed by the issue of a Permission Form.
claims.notes: A document the applicant receives after applying. Split during IND-91 part B lint remediation into the issue of the form, what it contains and who issues it.

claims.text: The manual states that the Permission Form enlists various approvals and conditions.
claims.notes: Split during IND-91 part B lint remediation from claim_mumbai_water_permission_form_issued. What the form contains is separately checkable from the fact that it is issued.

claims.text: The manual states that the permission form is issued by the Assistant Engineer Water Works of the ward.
claims.notes: Split during IND-91 part B lint remediation from claim_mumbai_water_permission_form_issued. Who issues the form is the fragment the owner cell rests on.

claims.text: The ward water works RTI manual's time limit table names preparation of a Permission Form or a rejection letter as a step.
claims.notes: A refusal reaches the applicant as a letter; the manual does not say whether the letter carries reasons. Split during IND-91 part B lint remediation into the preparation step and the signature step.

claims.text: That table names signature of the permission form or rejection letter by the Assistant Engineer Water Works as the step after it.
claims.notes: Split during IND-91 part B lint remediation from claim_mumbai_water_rejection_letter_step. The signature step is separately checkable from the preparation step.

claims.text: The ward water works RTI manual states that after compliance with the conditions of the permission form the water connection is released to the applicant.

The ward water works RTI manual states that complaints about water supply can be registered with the Complaint Officer of the respective ward office and also with the Water Control Office in the city.
claims.notes: A route for a supply complaint, not for the progress of a connection application.

claims.text: The corporation's New Water Connection route publishes only two application forms, one for the slum category and one for other categories.
claims.notes: Direct current observation of the folder listing on the access date. Split during IND-91 part B lint remediation into what the route publishes, when the files were last changed and what it omits.

claims.text: Each of those two forms was last changed on 18 September 2015.
claims.notes: Split during IND-91 part B lint remediation from claim_mumbai_water_nwc_route_is_forms_only. Read from the folder listing's own 'Changed On' column.

claims.text: That route carries no guidance on eligibility or documents or charges or timelines or offices.
claims.notes: Split during IND-91 part B lint remediation from claim_mumbai_water_nwc_route_is_forms_only. Each topic named was searched for on the route and none was present.

claims.text: Once a connection exists, the corporation's water citizen portal lets a consumer download a duplicate bill or a duplicate receipt by entering the consumer number, without login.
claims.notes: A surface that follows the connection, not the application; recorded for completeness and not used for the after-submission cell. The route was read only, with no consumer number entered. Basis boundary: the observation is of what the public page showed on the access date, duplicate bill and duplicate receipt options keyed to a consumer number and reachable without login; that a download is actually delivered is an inference from those published options, because confirming it would have required entering a real consumer number and querying live case data.

claims.text: Whether an applicant for a new water connection can check the progress of the application on any public route is not established by any reviewed public page.
claims.notes: Retained because the uncertainty itself matters to the journey. Not login-related. Split during IND-91 part B lint remediation; the reference-number unknown is asserted separately.

claims.text: What reference number the applicant is given when the papers are lodged is not established by any reviewed public page.
claims.notes: Split during IND-91 part B lint remediation from claim_mumbai_water_application_status_route_unknown. Retained because the uncertainty itself matters to the journey. Not login-related.

claims.text: What the citizen pays for the connection itself, beyond the Rs. 200 scrutiny fee, is not established by any reviewed public page.
claims.notes: Retained because the uncertainty itself matters to the journey. Not login-related; the charges manual is recorded as obtainable only from the PRO department on payment of fees. Split during IND-91 part B lint remediation; the specific figures searched for are asserted separately.

claims.text: No figure is published on any route reviewed for a deposit or a connection charge or a meter cost or a road-opening charge.
claims.notes: Split during IND-91 part B lint remediation from claim_mumbai_water_connection_charges_unknown. Each figure named was searched for on the reviewed routes and none was present.
